decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey rear conservatory to the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers 06.3587.P4, received 21 December 2006; and 06.3587.P3, 06.3587.P5 and 06.3587.P6, received 14 February 2007, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the existing street scene and would satisfactorily maintain the appearance and character of the conservation area and the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a conservatory to rear of house
